actions.value: On sunlit, melancholy Lordor, you unravel the mechanisms to recover the glyph tablets and restore the Star Tower.
Every site is sealed, and every key lies somewhere else.
The Squatters' Row Relic hums. It opens the Catacombs.
The seal on the Catacombs breaks.
The Vine Court is sealed by the Catacombs Relic.
The Catacombs Relic hums. It opens the Vine Court.
The seal on the Vine Court breaks.
The Squatters' Row is sealed by the Star Tower Relic.
The Star Tower Relic hums. It opens the Squatters' Row.
The seal on the Squatters' Row breaks.
The Dig Site is sealed by the Vine Court Relic.
The Vine Court Relic hums. It opens the Dig Site.
The seal on the Dig Site breaks.
You are badly hurt. Back off and recover.

nodes.speaker: Professor Tobin
nodes.text: So you've come to Expedition Camp at last. I am Professor Tobin. On sunlit, melancholy Lordor, you unravel the mechanisms to recover the glyph tablets and restore the Star Tower.

choices.text: What do you need from me?

nodes.speaker: Professor Tobin
nodes.text: Back again. Expedition Camp is quieter while you're out there.

nodes.speaker: Professor Tobin
nodes.text: Go to Squatters' Row, then Dig Site. Whatever still remembers The Sealed Vaults of the Sunken Ruins is out there. Bring it back to me.

nodes.speaker: Professor Tobin
nodes.text: Before anyone lived in Expedition Camp, The Sealed Vaults of the Sunken Ruins was kept by people who wrote nothing down. Mysterious, even then.

nodes.speaker: Professor Tobin
nodes.text: Squatters' Row: Squatters' Row: a village on the way out from Expedition Camp.

nodes.speaker: Professor Tobin
nodes.text: You found something out there. I can see it on you. That's one piece of The Sealed Vaults of the Sunken Ruins back where it belongs.

nodes.speaker: Professor Tobin
nodes.text: Dig Site: Dig Site: a camp on the way out from Expedition Camp.

nodes.speaker: Kai the Scholar
nodes.text: Kai the Scholar circles your feet, then looks toward Vine Court as if it already knows the way.

nodes.speaker: Kai the Scholar
nodes.text: Kai the Scholar keeps close and glances back at Expedition Camp.

nodes.speaker: Kai the Scholar
nodes.text: It turns toward Vine Court. Vine Court: a grove on the way out from Expedition Camp.

nodes.speaker: Gate Warden
nodes.text: Halt. Gate Warden, of the watch at Expedition Camp. Keep to the paths out there.

nodes.speaker: Gate Warden
nodes.text: Still in one piece? Good. Keep it that way.

nodes.speaker: Gate Warden
nodes.text: Unstable ground near the old structures. Worst near Squatters' Row.

nodes.speaker: Bram the Trader
nodes.text: Welcome to my corner of Expedition Camp. Bram the Trader's wares have come a long way to get here.

nodes.speaker: Bram the Trader
nodes.text: Rope, oil, dried fruit, and maps of The Sealed Vaults of the Sunken Ruins that are only a little wrong. Nothing you can't find for yourself, if you're patient.

nodes.speaker: Bram the Trader
nodes.text: People say lights move at Squatters' Row after dark. I don't go there myself.

nodes.speaker: Ruin Moth
nodes.text: The ruin moth freezes, watches you with one bright eye, and looks ready to bolt.
